mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.employee_id AS employeeId, e.name AS name, s.salary_month AS salaryMonth, s.attendance_days AS attendanceDays, s.base_salary AS baseSalary, s.bonus, s.deduction, s.tax, s.real_salary AS realSalary, s.salary_status AS salaryStatus, s.create_time AS createTime FROM salary s LEFT JOIN employee e ON s.employee_id = e.id ORDER BY s.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO salary ( employee_id, salary_month, attendance_days, base_salary, bonus, deduction, tax, real_salary, salary_status, create_time ) VALUES ( #{employeeId}, #{salaryMonth}, #{attendanceDays}, #{baseSalary}, #{bonus}, #{deduction}, #{tax}, #{realSalary}, #{salaryStatus}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, base_salary AS baseSalary FROM employee ORDER BY id
SELECT employee_id AS employeeId, SUM(money) AS money FROM bonus WHERE DATE_FORMAT( bonus_month, '%Y-%m' ) = #{salaryMonth} GROUP BY employee_id
